toast_body: Extract the text to work with Claude?
started:
Watcher is active.
Take a screenshot (Win+Shift+S) to extract text.
copied:
Text copied to clipboard!
Paste it with Ctrl+V straight into Claude.
warning:
Text copied, but the quality looks doubtful: {reasons}.
Check it before sending, or retake a smaller or zoomed-in capture.
timeout: The operation took longer than 120 seconds.
